corrections.text: The headline's "2x to 5x ... on Small Requests" rests on two measured request sizes: the benchmark page measured only 1 item per request (5.0x) and 16 items (2.0x, a size the page labels "medium"; it labels only the 1-item case "small"), plus 128 items (1.14x). No intermediate sizes were measured, so the range is not shown for them.

The 2.0x to 5.0x ratios are for the benchmark's 20 ms p99 latency budget. The page's reference tables give 1.9x at 16 items under a 10 ms budget, 1.3x under 50 ms and 1.5x with no limit, and 3.4x at 1 item with no limit; the page also says the 1-item XSE figure of 30,100 examples/s is a lower bound on its 20 ms capacity.
